sidebar.alongIntro: Controlled and restricted airspace within ~10 km of your planned line. Select the ones to carry into your briefing, or click any zone on the map, whatever its class. The info button shows everything known about a zone before you pick it.
sidebar.scanning: Scanning the airspace along your flight…
sidebar.loadFailed: The airspace data could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
sidebar.noneFound: No controlled or restricted airspace found along your flight. You can still draw your own zones below.
sidebar.selectionEmpty: Nothing selected yet. Your briefing's OpenAir file will contain whatever you pick here (plus the NOTAMs from the next step).

hints.select: Click the map to list the airspaces at that point. Only airspaces along your flight can be selected.
hints.polygonFirst: Click the map to place the first point.
hints.polygonMore: {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}: double-click (or use Finish) to close the polygon.
hints.rectangleFirst: Click the map to place the first corner.
hints.cylinderFirst: Click the map to place the centre.
hints.cylinderNext: Click again to set the radius.

sidebar.sourceHint: Selection uses whatever the map shows: openAIP airspaces by default, or your OpenAir file when one is loaded.

designDialog.shapePolygon: Polygon · {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
designDialog.name: Name
designDialog.scheduleOn: Active only during these windows, like a NOTAM-activated zone. Leave the end empty for “until further notice”.
designDialog.scheduleOff: Always active. Turn on to restrict this zone to activation windows, like official airspaces activated by NOTAM.

errors.ceilingAboveFloor: The ceiling must be above the floor.

errors.startRequired: Each activation window needs a start date and time.
errors.endInvalid: Enter a valid end date and time (or leave it empty).
errors.endBeforeStart: An activation window must end after it starts.
errors.noWindow: Add at least one activation window.

openArea.title: Dynamic open area
openArea.intro: While a window below is open, this volume becomes open airspace (a glider sector / flex zone) and is cut out of every overlapping airspace in your briefing's OpenAir file. Outside the windows, all airspaces keep their full shape.
openArea.hoursPreset: Pre-filled from this zone's own activation hours. Review or adjust them before saving.
openArea.hoursExisting: The hours this designation was saved with. Adjust as needed.
openArea.hoursEmpty: This zone carries no activation hours. Define when the area opens. Leave the end empty for “until further notice”.

designer.polygonTooFew: A polygon needs at least 3 points.
designer.outlinePartial: Could not fetch this airspace's full outline, using the visible part.
designer.outlineFailed: Could not read this airspace's outline.

designLayer.overlayOff: Turn on the Airspaces overlay to pick airspaces.

detail.permanentlyActive: Permanently active: the file declares no schedule
detail.noName: This airspace has no name in the map data, so it can’t be looked up on openAIP. {source, select, file {What your OpenAir file declares is shown above.} other {Only what the map already knows is shown above.}}
detail.notConfigured: Live openAIP details aren’t configured on this server. {source, select, file {What your OpenAir file declares is shown above.} other {Only what the map already knows is shown above.}}
detail.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the full details from openAIP right now. {source, select, file {What your OpenAir file declares is shown above.} other {Only what the map already knows is shown above.}}
detail.notFoundFile: No matching airspace in the openAIP database. This zone comes from your own file, so what it declares is all there is.
detail.notFound: No matching airspace was found in the openAIP database.

cut.title: Vertical airspace cut
cut.nothing: Nothing to cut yet. Open a flight or add at least two points.
cut.errorArea: This path covers too large an area for the vertical cut. Zoom the route into a smaller region.
cut.errorTiles: The airspace tiles could not be loaded. Close and reopen to retry.
cut.tilesFailed: Some airspace tiles failed to load, so the cut is incomplete.
cut.noTerrain: No terrain data along this path: ground-referenced airspace limits are not shown.
cut.footer: Controlled & restricted airspace only · {clickable, select, yes {click a band for full details · } other {}}{source, select, user {your OpenAir file} other {openAIP data}}. Informative only, never a substitute for official aeronautical information.

notamStep.connectIntro: European NOTAMs come from Eurocontrol EAD via autorouter, whose licence lets each pilot access the feed with their own account, not through a shared one.
notamStep.linkIntro: Link your free autorouter account to switch NOTAMs on. It only ever shows your briefing.
notamStep.skip: You can skip this step: your briefing will simply carry no NOTAMs.
notamStep.disclaimer: Advisory only: this is NOT an official briefing. Always check the official pre-flight information sources (AIS/NOTAM briefing) before flying.
notamStep.alongIntroDated: NOTAMs within ~10 km of your planned line, active on {date}. Select the ones to carry into your briefing.
notamStep.alongIntroUndated: NOTAMs within ~10 km of your planned line, active on your flight date. Select the ones to carry into your briefing.
notamStep.beyondHorizon: Your flight date is more than 7 days out. Most NOTAMs are only published closer to the day. Re-check this step nearer your flight.
notamStep.loadFailed: NOTAMs could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
notamStep.none: No active NOTAM along your flight for that date: a clean sky. Click the map to probe a specific spot.
notamStep.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# NOTAM} other {# NOTAMs}} selected for the briefing.
notamStep.probeNone: No active NOTAM over this point for the selected filters.
notamStep.lowerLimitHint: Hides NOTAMs whose airspace starts above this altitude.
notamStep.dataNote: Data: your autorouter account (Eurocontrol EAD, the authoritative source for European NOTAMs), fetched live for your flight corridor. Some NOTAMs, notably ones without parseable geometry, may not appear on the map.

notamList.title: NOTAMs here
notamList.description: {count, plural, one {# NOTAM} other {# NOTAMs}} at this point, restrictions first. Select one to highlight it on the map.

notamPopup.outlineFromOpenAip: Outline from openAIP (matched to the named area).
notamPopup.disclaimer: Advisory only: this is NOT an official briefing. Always check the official pre-flight information sources (AIS/NOTAM briefing) before flying.
